Maya (AE): Harper reports the POC UI crashes on some streamed completions. Browser shows `Unexpected token NUL (0x00)` during JSON.parse. No 5xx from backend.
Harper (Client): Repro steps: open SSE to /poc/stream, after a few events one payload fails parse. Curl hexdump shows: 7d 0a 0a 64 61 74 61 3a 20 7b 22 id\":\"abc\" 7d 00 0a 0a — there is a 0x00 between events.
Jin (SE): 0x00 is the immediate suspect. Could be CDN/edge padding, an Envoy filter, or nginx buffer padding. What sits in front of the app?
Harper (Client): Akamai edge -> internal Envoy -> nginx -> app.
Ravi (Oncall): Common mitigations: disable response buffering on the streaming route at each layer, ensure chunked transfer encoding and no Content-Length header, and set sendfile off on nginx for dynamic streams. Envoy filters can also add sentinel bytes when doing HTTP/2->HTTP/1.1 conversions.
Zoe (Eng): On Redwood we've seen TLS stack reassembly or CDN normalization introduce NUL padding. Quick debug: run `curl -N -v https://host/poc/stream > s.bin` then `xxd -g1 s.bin | sed -n '1,120p'` and search for 00 bytes near the blank-line separator.
Harper (Client): Bypassing Akamai (direct to Envoy) removed the 0x00 in our repro. So the edge is the likely source.
Jin (SE): Short-term client workaround: accumulate raw SSE bytes until you observe the blank-line separator (CRLF CRLF) and strip any NUL (0x00) bytes before JSON.parse. Example pattern (pseudocode):
```
buffer = ""
on data(chunk):
  buffer += chunk as utf8
  while separator in buffer:
    evt = slice up to separator
    buffer = remainder
    payloadLines = lines in evt that start with 'data:'
    payload = join payloadLines
    payload = payload.replace('\u0000','')  // remove NULs
    try parse JSON(payload)
```
This avoids client crashes while infra is fixed.
Lina (Presales): is it OK to enable tenant runtime flag `sse_strict_boundary=true` for this POC?
Zoe (Eng): Yes, low risk. We'll enable it for the tenant and capture telemetry for any dropped bytes. Document in POC notes.
Ravi (Oncall): I'll draft an infra note with concrete Akamai and Envoy guidance: disable response buffering for stream paths, disable HTTP/2 response buffering on the CDN, avoid Content-Length, and ensure proxies preserve exact event boundaries.
Harper (Client): After bypassing Akamai and adding client buffering the stream has been stable for 18 hours. We'll roll changes carefully on the production domain.
edge-bot: Deployed poc/edge-stream-fix to staging (build #1201).
Maya (AE): Action items: 1) Ravi/Zoe publish the infra snippet to the POC doc, 2) Jin/Lina add the runtime toggle and client workaround to the wrap-up. Thanks team — nice swoop. :tada:
